description: This file defines the ProjectDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to modify Project entities such as setting customers and project admins.

classes.name: ProjectDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Project entity, adding methods to manage project customer and administrators.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a Project entity.

methods.name: setCustomerById
methods.description: Sets the customer for the project based on a customer ID.

methods.name: setProjectAdminsByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Assigns project administrators based on a list of employee numbers.

methods.name: addProjectAdmin
methods.description: Adds an Employee as a project admin if not already present.

methods.name: removeProjectAdmins
methods.description: Removes all project admins from the project.
